product_family: Modular household furniture and appliance platform
intended_use: A repairable kitchen island with a long-lived furniture structure and replaceable refrigeration/freezer and optional induction modules.

items.material_or_specification: Candidate timber, engineered-panel, or metal structure; final selection requires load, moisture, repair, sourcing, and lifecycle review.
items.notes: No material grade, joint, finish, or allowable load has been released.

items.material_or_specification: Refrigeration/freezer appliance module selected only after capacity, energy, ventilation, refrigerant-safety, serviceability, and market requirements are defined.
items.notes: No appliance make/model has been selected or qualified.

items.material_or_specification: Optional certified third-party induction module; no model selected. Omit the module if separation, ventilation, electrical, or spill-safety requirements cannot be met.
items.notes: A conceptual placeholder, not permission to fabricate or energize an improvised cooktop.

interfaces.thermal_boundary: Provisional only. Final bay must follow the selected appliance manufacturer's ventilation, installation, and heat-rejection requirements; thermal interaction with any cooktop must be tested.
Provisional only. Final requirements must follow the exact selected cooktop instructions and qualified assessment; separate heat and spill paths from refrigerated storage.

service_policy.compatibility_policy: The 20-year value is a programme target, not a supplier commitment. Replacement modules require full interface, safety, electrical, ventilation, thermal, and service-access compatibility review.

metrics.statement: Replace the defined major appliance module without destructive disassembly of the permanent furniture structure.
metrics.comparison_baseline: No destructive change to permanent structure.
metrics.measurement_method: Timed removal-and-replacement trial with trained technicians; record tools, time, damage, rework, and successful reassembly.

metrics.statement: Target maximum replacement duration for the defined module swap.
metrics.measurement_method: Repeated timed technician trials on the released assembly and service instructions; publish median, range, failures, and trial conditions.

metrics.statement: Investigate at least 15% lower energy use than a matched certified baseline, if a defensible size/capacity/use-matched comparison exists.
metrics.comparison_baseline: To be selected and justified before testing.
metrics.measurement_method: Instrumented energy testing under declared ambient, load, door-cycle, and recovery conditions; compare matched capacities and state measurement uncertainty.

metrics.statement: Design horizon for the permanent furniture structure.
metrics.measurement_method: Materials/joints rationale, replaceable wear strategy, accelerated tests with stated limits, supplier continuity plan, and long-term field evidence. This is not a demonstrated lifetime.

release_gates.requirement: Applicable appliance/electrical/fire/refrigerant and installation requirements reviewed for the exact configuration.
Integrated enclosure preserves the selected refrigeration module's declared airflow and thermal conditions, including cooktop interaction if installed.
Defined structural load, stability, fastening, fatigue, and foreseeable-misuse requirements pass documented tests.
The designated module can be removed and replaced using the approved service procedure without destructive disassembly.
The BOM, released geometry, interface revisions, installation instructions, and tested physical build are revision-consistent.
